evidence: The 0x2AAAAAAB divide-by-12 and the 0xB/0xC clamp values are visible, but two row values come from unaff_r5/unaff_r6, the function sits in the unreferenced 0x6E5xxx Thumb fragment block and ends in an unrecovered jump table.

name: maybe_Ui_List_ScrollByDeltaThumb

name: maybe_Ui_List_SelectById

name: maybe_Ui_Row_Activate

evidence: The count from record+0xC, the visible-row call (vtable+0x68), the page*5 arithmetic and maybe_Ui_ScrollList_ScrollBy are present, but the 'advance page' reading depends on what the 5 means and no caller shows the scroll direction.

The record comes from the same action id (0x63FD24) as the post-hit code, and nothing is monster-specific, so the old Monster_Model wording was too narrow.

name: maybe_Pack_DecodeResource
signature: void maybe_Pack_DecodeResource(int pack, u32 offset, u32 size, u32 flags)

name: Ui_WindowResource_Reset
summary: Rebuilds the resource holder: when the dirty byte at +4 is set it releases the three cached objects (+0x8/+0xC/+0x10), then creates a 200-byte curve animator, a 0x80 and a 0x84 animator (only the 0x80 one when the argument is non-zero), hands the 200-byte object to Field_InitSceneObjects with vtable 0x00782234 and re-sets the dirty byte.

summary: One-shot constructor of a 0x37C-byte field scene object: lazily allocates the backing block through 0x0011FE8C/0x0011CFAC, zeroes it, installs the vtable, sets the 0xFF/0 defaults and constructs the eight 8-byte sub-records at +0x2C.

summary: Lazy one-time construction of the engine's 0x37C-byte global UI/service singleton at g_007BE2F0 (vtable 0x00782928): zeroes the block, installs the vtable and returns the nested sub-object at +0x33C; the once flag is cleared after construction.

summary: Iterates active units in the action sequence's 16 battle slots (+0x70) carrying battle state 0x76 or 0x11B while otherActor->u16_B18C == 0x76, clears u16_B18C to 0xFFFF, syncs the HP percentage, resets the idle animation and calls vt[+0x98](actor, 1.0f, 0.1f).
